description: A background subagent (run_in_background): its call returns at once, it carries on after the turn ends, and when it's done Claude starts a turn by itself to say so.

command.text: Use the Agent tool with run_in_background set to true to start a general-purpose subagent with this prompt: 'Run `sleep 3` with the Bash tool, then read notes.txt with the Read tool and reply with its first line only.' Don't wait for it: reply with just: started
